name: Exp_ColorTrend_CF
summary: This EA trades trend reversals detected by the ColorTrend_CF custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the indicator's upper line crosses above the lower line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management settings.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorTrend_CF自定义指标的趋势反转信号进行交易。当指标上线穿越下线时开多仓，反之开空仓，支持可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理参数。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorTrend_CF指标的双线交叉判断趋势方向，属于典型的趋势跟踪型策略。入场条件为：当上线从下方穿越下线时产生买入信号，当上线从上方穿越下线时产生卖出信号，使用SignalBar参数指定的K线来获取信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号触发时平仓（如买入信号出现时平空仓，卖出信号出现时平多仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，没有在代码中直接看到更细致的风控逻辑。策略仅在出现新K线时检测信号，避免同一K线内重复交易，这是一个较好的设计。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the crossover of two lines from the ColorTrend_CF custom indicator to determine trend direction, making it a classic trend-following system. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the upper line crosses above the lower line, and a sell signal is generated when the upper line crosses below the lower line, using the bar specified by the SignalBar parameter for signal retrieval. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, plus closing positions on opposite signals — long positions close on sell signals and short positions close on buy signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent a fixed lot size and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management relies on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, with no finer risk control logic visible in the code itself. The strategy only checks signals on new bar formation, preventing repeated trades within the same bar, which is a sound design choice.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Money management: controls lot size or ratio

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
买卖和平仓权限可独立控制，灵活性高，适合不同市场环境
使用止损止盈设置，有基本的风险控制框架
信号检测与交易执行分离，代码结构清晰
pros_en: New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Buy, sell, and close permissions can be independently controlled, offering high flexibility for different market conditions
Uses stop loss and take profit settings, providing a basic risk control framework
Signal detection and trade execution are cleanly separated, resulting in clear code structure
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标ColorTrend_CF，无法独立验证指标逻辑的可靠性
没有点差过滤和滑点保护机制，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，可能导致单笔亏损严重
缺少持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
MM参数为负值代表固定手数的设计不直观，容易误操作
cons_en: Depends on the external custom indicator ColorTrend_CF, making it impossible to independently verify the indicator's reliability
No spread filter or slippage protection mechanism, which may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large, potentially causing severe single-trade losses
Lacks position checking logic, which may lead to duplicate position openings in the same direction
The MM parameter design where negative values mean fixed lot size is unintuitive and prone to misconfiguration
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
添加点差过滤条件，在点差过大时暂停交易
将MM参数拆分为手数模式和比例模式两个独立参数，提高可读性
增加追踪止损功能，在趋势延续时保护已有利润
improvements_en: Add position checking logic to prevent duplicate openings in the same direction
Add a spread filter to pause trading when the spread is too wide
Split the MM parameter into separate lot-size mode and percentage mode parameters for better readability
Add a trailing stop feature to protect profits when the trend continues

risk_points: 默认止损1000点过大，单笔亏损风险较高
缺少持仓检查可能导致重复开仓放大风险敞口
依赖外部指标库，指标失败时仅有Recount重试机制而无告警
risk_points_en: Default stop loss of 1000 points is excessively large, creating high single-trade loss risk
Lack of position checking may lead to duplicate openings that amplify risk exposure
Dependency on external indicator library with only a Recount retry mechanism and no alert on indicator failure
